methods.code: The app first filters daily rows to the selected month (or all available months), then selects Overall, Land only, or With flight rows for Hotel config, DIY Maldives, and Overall Maldives. Land-only and with-flight views also retain the explicit Overall Maldives / Overall rows as the common benchmark. For each Q2O point, divide the selected numerator by its denominator. For each trailing seven-calendar-day point d, sum numerator and denominator from d-6 through d and divide the sums; missing cohort-day rows contribute neither numerator nor denominator. The first six dates in the selected period are omitted.

source.label: Holiday Dash Maldives ticket and quote conversion aggregate
filters: First observed quote date: 2026-08-09 00:00 IST through 2026-09-17 23:59 IST
DIY Maldives: packageDetail.tagDestination.name = Maldives and packageDetail.id = 0
With flight: packageDetail.flightDetail.component = FLIGHT; all remaining rows are Land only
Overall: independently deduplicated across Land only and With flight for each cohort; distinct tickets are not added across setups
Rows missing ticketId or quoteId are excluded from both conversion denominators

metricDefinitions.label: Ticket Q2O
metricDefinitions.definition: Unique booked ticket IDs divided by unique ticket IDs for the same cohort and setup. A ticket is booked when any of its quotes has isBookedQuote true, and is assigned to its first observed quote date in the reporting window.

metricDefinitions.label: Quote Q2O
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct booked quote IDs divided by distinct quote IDs for the same cohort and setup. A quote is booked when isBookedQuote is true, and is assigned to its first observed date in the reporting window.

metricDefinitions.label: Unique tickets
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct non-empty ticketId values. Each ticket is counted once within a cohort and setup and assigned to its first observed quote date.

metricDefinitions.label: Booked tickets
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct ticketId values with at least one isBookedQuote = true.

metricDefinitions.label: Quotes sent
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct non-empty quoteId values assigned to their first observed date.

metricDefinitions.label: Booked quotes
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct quoteId values with isBookedQuote = true.

metricDefinitions.label: 7-day rolling Q2O
metricDefinitions.definition: Trailing seven-calendar-day numerator divided by trailing seven-calendar-day denominator for the selected Ticket or Quote Q2O view. This is a weighted conversion rate, not an arithmetic mean of daily percentages.
metricDefinitions.formula: SUM(numerator, trailing 7 days) / SUM(denominator, trailing 7 days)

source.method: The custom Mongo aggregate filters the reporting window, creates Hotel config, DIY Maldives, and Overall Maldives memberships for Land only, With flight, and an independently deduplicated Overall setup, then deduplicates quoteId and ticketId within each membership. Tickets and quotes are assigned to their first observed date; booking status is the maximum isBookedQuote flag. The month selector filters these reviewed daily rows before every dashboard rollup.
